title: LADM LA_AdministrativeSource
description: Source with administrative/legal content (Deed, Title, Contract, Decision). An instance must be associated to one or more parties (at minimum the conveyancer). May be associated to BasicAdministrativeUnits and RRR instances.

allOf.$comment: INHERITANCE: Inherits everything from the abstract LA_Source
EXTENSIONS: Specific properties for Administrative Source

sourceType.description: Discriminator identifying this as an Administrative Source

type.description: CodeList: Type of administrative document. Covers values from LA_AdministrativeSourceType, LA_RightType, and LA_RestrictionType (e.g. deed, title, mortgage, easement, decision).

text.description: The content or legal text of the document (MIME type dependent)
